Module com.ecotwin
Package com.ecotwin.model

Class ScoreChange

java.lang.Object
com.ecotwin.model.ScoreChange
public class ScoreChange extends Object
US-23: the household's scores just before and just after an update to one domain. Before is null when the update gave the household its first full set of readings, so there was no score to compare against.
